title: Eyes on Sunrise
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A East, FL vacation rental at ‘Eyes on Sunrise’ a luxury 7-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 24 guests, this home offers a Private Pool/Spa, Game Room, & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Private Pool & Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • 2 Minute Walk to the Beach • Game Room with a Shuffleboard, Arcade Games and Bar • Balconies on all floors with Gulf Views • Beach Access Steps Away (approximately 300 ft) • Elevator • Six Seater Golf Cart & Six Adult Bikes Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: • Bedroom 1: King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR: • Bunk room 2: two full over Queen bunks (sleeps 8) – ensuite bathroom single vanity Shower/Tub Combo • Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combo • Primary Bedroom 4: King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities & tile/glass Shower & Soaking Tub • Guest Bedroom 5: King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & tile/glass Shower • Bunk room 6: Two Queen over Queen bunks (sleeps 8) – Ensuite bathroom single vanity and tile/glass shower THIRD FLOOR: • Primary Bedroom 7: King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities, large walk-in shower with soaking tub enclosed + Private Balcony DESCRIPTION: At ‘Eyes on Sunrise’, every moment is designed to immerse you in the essence of coastal living, where the sun’s warm rays beckon you to explore the pristine shores of 30A. As you awaken to the soothing sounds of the Gulf of Mexico, your day unfolds with a myriad of options right at your fingertips, from beach walks to sunset strolls. Gather around the private pool & spa, where laughter mingles with the salty air, creating memories that linger long after you’ve returned home. With thoughtfully curated spaces that blend comfort and elegance, ‘Eyes on Sunrise’ transforms your vacation into a sanctuary of relaxation, inviting you to create cherished moments with loved ones in a stunning backdrop of Florida’s emerald Coast. Nestled along the stunning South Walton's Scenic Highway 30A in Inlet Beach, Florida, ‘Eyes on Sunrise’ is a luxurious beachfront retreat that captures the essence of the ideal coastal getaway. This magnificent seven-bedroom, eight-and-a-half-bathroom home offers breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico, a private heated pool, a relaxing hot tub, an elevator, and parking for up to 7 vehicles, making it perfect for hosting up to 26 guests in unparalleled comfort and style. Just steps away from the beach, you can easily sink your toes into the soft, sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast, and with ample on-site parking, enjoy the tranquility of the area while remaining close to stunning Alys Beach and The Big Chill. An elevator provides effortless access to all levels of the home, simplifying the transport of luggage, groceries, and beach essentials, while enhancing mobility and adding an element of sophistication to your stay. Greet each day with the mesmerizing panorama of the Gulf, sipping your morning coffee on expansive balconies while the soothing sea breeze envelops you and the waves gently lap the shore. Your experience at ‘Eyes on Sunrise’ is complemented by exceptional amenities; including a refreshing private pool, which can be heated for your convenience, and a hot tub ideal for relaxing stargazing. For those eager to explore the area, the ‘Eyes on Sunrise’ includes six adult bicycles for a delightful way to immerse yourself in the scenic charm of 30A. This splendid home features seven well-appointed bedrooms and eight full bathrooms, ensuring every guest enjoys privacy and comfort, along with an inviting living room, first floor game room and three kitchens/kitchenettes for convenience. Relive joyful moments with a selection of arcade games that promise endless entertainment for guests of all ages in the first-floor game room. The home's design is a contemporary interpretation of classic beach architecture, highlighting high ceilings, solid surface flooring, and generous outdoor spaces that allow you to bask in the coastal ambiance from every angle. A ground-floor bedroom and family room seamlessly open onto the outdoor pool deck, encouraging families and guests to embrace the inviting poolside atmosphere. Expansive living and dining areas inspire culinary talents or can comfortably accommodate a private chef or a wine tasting class. Two levels of spacious balconies provide stunning vistas, and the private pool is destined to be a favored gathering place as dinner sizzles on the grill. ‘Eyes on Sunrise’ is dedicated to delivering an unforgettable beachfront vacation experience, meticulously designed to blend modern comforts with timeless coastal allure. With six bikes at your disposal, and a complimentary six-seater golf cart available, the natural beauty of 30A at is your fingertips. CONVENIENT LOCATION • The Big Chill – Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (0.9 Miles) • Alys Beach - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (1.8 Miles) • Seacrest Beach - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (2.4 Miles) • Rosemary Beach - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (2.5 Miles) • 30Avenue - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (3.0 Miles) • Publix at WaterSound Origins (2.5 Miles)
